prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Survival Arena field-selection thumbnail. Primary request: a radiant rift between earth and heaven forming a dangerous traversal arena. Scene/backdrop: fractured white-stone platforms, monumental arches, luminous non-damaging cracks, clouds below, fragments of earthly fortress stone transitioning into celestial architecture. Subject: alternating broad open platforms and dense obstacle clusters connected by substantial intact causeways; a colossal open white-stone arch framing the sky as landmark. Style/medium: polished hand-drawn stylized storybook cutout environment illustration; flat 2D shapes, thick slightly irregular ink outlines, matte colors, simple cel shading, subtle paper texture; warm ironic fairy-tale danger; not pixel art, not photorealistic, not 3D. Composition/framing: landscape 3:2, readable 3/4 top-down overview, clear traversable routes and obstacle rhythm, one strong environmental focal landmark, foreground framing kept subtle, works when center-cropped and downscaled to a 170-pixel-high UI card. Lighting/mood: luminous high-altitude radiance, awe and danger, readable forms without blown highlights. Color palette: pearl white, pale blue, soft lavender shadow, restrained celestial gold. Constraints: environment only; no characters, enemies, creatures, UI, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark; no close-up object; no map labels; preserve broad open gameplay space; visual cracks do not imply damage. Avoid: lava, lightning hazards, bottomless gaps dominating all routes, pure white washout.
